metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shares safe, easy exercises designed to relieve arthritis symptoms such as stiffness, aches, and muscle tightness.

These simple movements target spinal osteoarthritis (wear-and-tear arthritis), spinal stenosis, and degenerative disc disease. They help lengthen and strengthen your spine while keeping your back in a safe, pain-free position.

To make it even easier, the video is broken into a step-by-step guide to provide both quick and long-lasting relief.

Best of all, no equipment is needed, and some exercises may bring relief in as little as 30 seconds!

Watch now and quickly relieve lower back arthritis pain from the comfort of your home.
